title: feat(types): align all packages with @objectstack/spec v2.0.1 protocol
body:
Audit and align all packages against the canonical `@objectstack/spec` v2.0.1 protocol. Core issue: missing namespace re-exports, locally redefined types that should be imported from spec, and stale version references throughout.

### Namespace & utility re-exports

- Added 6 missing namespace re-exports: `Kernel`, `Contracts`, `Integration`, `Studio`, `Identity`, `Security`
- Added `defineStack`, `definePlugin`, `PluginContext` and all capability schemas/types (`ObjectStackSchema`, `ObjectStackDefinitionSchema`, etc.)

```typescript
import { defineStack, Kernel, Contracts, Integration, Studio, Identity, Security } from '@object-ui/types';
```

### Canonical type imports (Rule: "Never Redefine Types")

- **objectql.ts**: Replaced local definitions of `HttpMethod`, `HttpRequest`, `ViewData`, `ListColumn`, `SelectionConfig`, `PaginationConfig` with `import type` from `@objectstack/spec/ui`
- **theme.ts**: Replaced local definitions of `ColorPalette`, `Typography`, `Spacing`, `BorderRadius`, `Shadow`, `Breakpoints`, `Animation`, `ZIndex`, `ThemeMode` with spec imports
- `Theme` kept local — spec's Zod-inferred type has `mode` required (via `ZodDefault`), ObjectUI needs it optional

### Zod schema boundary

`@objectstack/spec` uses Zod v3; `@object-ui/types` uses Zod v4. Runtime schema import is impossible across this boundary. Local Zod schemas mirror spec structurally with updated JSDoc noting this constraint.

### Version reference cleanup

- Updated all `v0.7.1` / `v0.6.1` JSDoc references → `v2.0.1` across `packages/types`, `packages/core`, `apps/console`

### Tests

- Rewrote `namespace-exports.test.ts` to verify new exports (`defineStack`, `definePlugin`, `ObjectStackSchema`, capability schemas)
